build_DPTModel_full: build a DPTModel with type full to predict both depth and segmentation from tactile images
build_DPTModel_depth: build a DPTModel with type depth to predict depth maps from tactile sensor images
build_DPTModel_segmentation: build a DPTModel with type segmentation to predict segmentation masks from tactile images
run_DPTModel_forward: run the DPTModel forward pass on an image tensor to get depth and segmentation outputs
review_DPTModel_hooks: review the DPTModel _get_layers_from_hooks method that registers forward hooks on transformer encoder blocks
